# Vendored Three.js modules

These files are from Three.js r160 and are used locally so the editor does not
depend on a CDN:

- `three.module.js`
- `controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `controls/TransformControls.js`
- `loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`

Upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160>
